name: Underclans
worldbuilding: Underground warrens, scavenger cities, thieves' confederacies, alchemical guilds, and raiding clans. Their armies rely on numbers, dirty tricks, traps, and unconventional equipment.

factionRule.name: Strength in Numbers
factionRule.effect: Friendly Units containing at least 5 Models gain Accurate 2.

factionCommands.name: Dirty Trick
factionCommands.effect: Worsen one visible enemy's Armor or Evade by one step until the end of the Phase.

factionCommands.name: Scurry Away
factionCommands.effect: One friendly Unit may Disengage without becoming Withdrawn.

factionCommands.name: Mob Them!
factionCommands.effect: Up to two friendly Units may each Move up to 2" toward the same enemy within Medium.

factionCommands.name: Strike the Exposed
factionCommands.effect: Choose one friendly Unit within Short and one of these battlefield-role counters when activating: Anti-Support 4 or Anti-Ranged 4. That Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

abilities.name: Sneaky
abilities.effect: Gain Concealed while benefiting from Cover.

abilities.name: Knife in the Dark
abilities.effect: When this Unit makes a Melee Attack while Concealed, improve its Knives Hit characteristic from 6+ to 5+ for that Attack. Concealed ends under its normal rules.

abilities.name: Unstable
abilities.effect: On a Blunder, this Unit suffers one Damage 1 Hit.

abilities.name: Overstuffed Bombs
abilities.effect: When declaring a Bombs Attack, spend 1 CP. Increase its printed Blast radius from 1" to 2" for that Attack. If the Attack Blunders, this Unit suffers one additional automatic Physical Hit at Damage 1 (Armor and Ward apply); this is separate from the existing Unstable Hit. This does not grant another Attack.

abilities.name: Tunnel Ambush
abilities.effect: May begin in Reserve and deploy outside Short Range of enemies at the end of a Round. Cannot Charge in that Round.

abilities.name: Tunnel Strike
abilities.effect: The first eligible Melee Attack this Unit makes after entering from Reserve gains Anti-Infantry 2 and Accurate 1. This does not permit a Charge or Attack in the Round it arrives if ordinary Reserve rules forbid it.

abilities.name: Someone Else's Problem
abilities.effect: Transfer one Hit suffered by the Mob Boss to an eligible nearby friendly basic Model, which resolves its own saves.

abilities.name: Bad Luck
abilities.effect: Force one visible enemy within Medium to reroll one successful die, respecting the once-per-die reroll limit.

abilities.name: Snarefield
abilities.effect: Place a trap marker within Short. The first enemy crossing it before the end of the Round suffers Slow 1 and, on 4+, one Damage 1 Hit. Remove the marker after it triggers.

upgrades.name: Improvised Traps
upgrades.effect: The Trapmaster's Snarefield Command gains an additional option. When using Snarefield, choose one: Snarefield (resolve the original Command normally), or Smoke Canister (place a 25mm token within Short Range; the area within 1.5" blocks line of sight until the end of the Round). The Trapmaster may have only one token created through Improvised Traps on the battlefield at a time. Both options use the same Command and share its normal activation restrictions.

optionalUpgrades.name: Specialized Guidance
optionalUpgrades.effect: At list construction choose one existing creature/material Trait tag. Other friendly Units wholly within 3" gain Anti-[that tag] 2. Highest applicable Anti rank only. This is a passive aura, not a free Command; does not benefit its source.

abilities.name: Unreliable
abilities.effect: A Blunder on its Heavy Attack inflicts Direct Damage 1 on the Tank.

abilities.name: Subterranean Assault
abilities.effect: May begin in Reserve and deploy outside Short Range of enemies at the end of a Round. Cannot Charge in that Round.

abilities.name: A Thousand Escape Routes
abilities.effect: Once per Round, the Underking may Disengage without becoming Withdrawn.

abilities.name: Ordered Retreat
abilities.effect: Up to two friendly Units within Medium may immediately Disengage without becoming Withdrawn, then Move up to 2" and finish legally.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Large generic Line Infantry formations, standard archers and slingers, ordinary Scouts, and Light Cavalry. The Trapmaster is a specialized hybrid Support/Skirmisher without replacing the cheaper generic Scout.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Tunnel Rats as the faction's Extra Core, a Reserve-deploying Infiltrating unit reinforcing the Deep Strike doctrine rather than patching a weakness. Sneaks' weapon profile was kept unchanged (Models, not Attacks, is this faction's established horde-buff pattern for that Unit). Other Damage-1 weapons gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Infantry on the Scrap Tank's Ram, Anti-Armored on the Burrowing Engine's Grinding Drill) or an improved Hit (Scrap Cannon 5+ -> 4+, Royal Daggers 4+ -> 3+).
